summary_1line: Indra arranges Skanda’s marriage to Devasena, while abandoned celestial mothers claim him as son and receive roles influencing children and cosmic order.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra presents the richly adorned Devasena to Skanda as priests chant hymns and sacred fire burns during their divine wedding.
Six sorrowful wives of the sages stand before Skanda in his war camp, pleading to accept them as his mothers.
A fiery, terrifying spirit bursts from Skanda’s body and collapses to the ground, hungry and monstrous.
